properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.enabled
properties.description: Enable ArmorAuth's default JWT resource server security filter chain for /api/** endpoints.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.security-matcher
properties.description: Request matcher protected by the starter managed resource server security filter chain.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.permit-all
properties.description: Request patterns that remain public inside the resource server security matcher.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.csrf-enabled
properties.description: Whether CSRF protection remains enabled for the starter managed resource server chain.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.principal-claim
properties.description: JWT claim used as the Spring Security principal name.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.role-claims
properties.description: JWT claims mapped to role authorities.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.scope-claims
properties.description: JWT claims mapped to scope authorities.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.permission-claims
properties.description: JWT claims mapped to permission authorities.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.organization-role-claims
properties.description: JWT claims mapped to organization role authorities.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.role-prefix
properties.description: Authority prefix for values from role claims.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.scope-prefix
properties.description: Authority prefix for values from scope claims.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.permission-prefix
properties.description: Authority prefix for values from permission claims.

properties.name: armorauth.resource-server.organization-role-prefix
properties.description: Authority prefix for values from organization role claims.

properties.name: armorauth.oidc-client.enabled
properties.description: Enable ArmorAuth's default OIDC login security filter chain.

properties.name: armorauth.oidc-client.permit-all
properties.description: Request patterns that are public before OIDC login.

properties.name: armorauth.oidc-client.csrf-enabled
properties.description: Whether CSRF protection remains enabled for the starter managed OIDC client chain.

properties.name: armorauth.oidc-client.default-success-url
properties.description: Optional default URL after OIDC login.

properties.name: armorauth.oidc-client.logout-success-url
properties.description: Optional URL after logout.

properties.name: armorauth.admin-client.enabled
properties.description: Enable the starter managed ArmorAuth Admin API RestClient.

properties.name: armorauth.admin-client.base-url
properties.description: ArmorAuth server base URL used by the Admin API client.

properties.name: armorauth.admin-client.username
properties.description: Admin username for Basic authentication.

properties.name: armorauth.admin-client.password
properties.description: Admin password for Basic authentication.

properties.name: armorauth.admin-client.bearer-token
properties.description: Bearer token for Admin API authentication. Takes precedence over username/password.
